task_name: X-VLA 动作语义核验与离线基准测试

acceptance_criteria.name: 动作映射审计
acceptance_criteria.requirement: 20D 到 7D 映射有源码依据
acceptance_criteria.details: Audited against LeRobot XVLARotation6DToAxisAngleProcessorStep: Dims 0..2 target_eef, 3..8 rot6d_to_axis_angle, 9 gripper binarized (>0.5 -> 1.0, else -1.0).

acceptance_criteria.name: 位置语义
acceptance_criteria.requirement: 绝对位置与增量明确区分
acceptance_criteria.details: Model outputs Absolute Target EEF Position (m) in Base Frame (Z~0.65m), distinguished from dataset Normalized Delta Actions.

acceptance_criteria.name: 旋转语义
acceptance_criteria.requirement: 轴角与欧拉角明确区分
acceptance_criteria.details: Audited as 3D Axis-Angle Vector (radians, direction=axis, norm=angle in [0, pi]), not Euler Roll/Pitch/Yaw.

acceptance_criteria.name: 夹爪映射
acceptance_criteria.details: Binarized: -1.0 represents Gripper Open (张开), +1.0 represents Gripper Close (闭合抓取), verified against LIBERO dataset.

acceptance_criteria.name: 曲线标注
acceptance_criteria.details: ActionCurveCanvas displays Action Step Index (T0-T29, NOT seconds), physical units (m, rad, [-1,1]), and coordinate frame.

acceptance_criteria.name: 中文说明
acceptance_criteria.details: All panels (Model, Input, Action, Inference) and cards updated with Chinese bilingual subtitles and tooltips.

acceptance_criteria.name: 12 组推理
acceptance_criteria.requirement: 全部完成或记录明确失败原因

acceptance_criteria.name: 数据完整性
acceptance_criteria.requirement: 原始输出和后处理输出均保存
acceptance_criteria.details: Both raw_actions_20d (30, 20) and predicted_actions_7d (30, 7) saved for all 12 samples.

acceptance_criteria.name: 重复性
acceptance_criteria.requirement: 至少一组样本进行重复测试

acceptance_criteria.name: 历史兼容
acceptance_criteria.requirement: 不破坏 Task 015 历史记录
acceptance_criteria.details: Task 015 records intact; HistoryDialog supports multi-directory loading from both task015 and task016.
